data.body: **[P2] Do not fall back after an invocation-local header was captured.** A null/empty value from the new context accessor reaches this branch and reads the process-global system property/environment. With overlapping Managed Instances, that carrier can belong to another invocation, causing the headerless invocation to adopt its trace ID and sampling decision. Preserve accessor availability separately from its value and use global fallback only for the old-API compatibility path; add an overlap test with one missing header and a conflicting global carrier.
